tests.description: Reference: NCAR fire_behavior (develop @ eb77580, default real32 build, gfortran 13.3 -O2 in the EqWeFiC container) running its own test7 case (real Colorado domain, 80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, 20 steps, num_tiles = 1), dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit c9dda02, -DESM_DUMP=ON; the dumped run's summary output is bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single-precision source, so rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract); a real64 re-evaluation of the same formulae agrees with the dumps to <= 8e-7 relative. Regime: cell (i,j) = (19, 66), Runge-Kutta stage 1 of step 20 (t = 10 s, ls_tend dump call 58): wind and slope both project positively on the normal (cos_w 0.78, cos_s 0.57); phi_w = 53, phi_s = 0.095; ros = 0.757 m/s. Inputs are the dumped normal, mid-flame wind and slope of the cell and its Rothermel constants (ros_params dump, which the same run's level-set dump also carries as ros_* intermediates).
